description: Search bundled Orderly docs and SDK symbols by topic or question. Returns up to `limit` ranked Markdown results with relevance scores: `scope: 'sdk'` returns hooks/components/types/functions with signatures, props, and source paths; `'docs'` returns prose; `'auto'` (default) picks the corpus from the query. Use `'sdk'` for exact symbol signatures and `detail: 'full'` only when the summary is insufficient, since it returns much longer text. Read-only local search — no network calls, credentials, rate limits, or side effects. Use for open-ended discovery when the component, workflow, or endpoint is unknown; for a known component use get_component_guide, for a task walkthrough use explain_workflow, for an endpoint use get_api_info, get_indexer_api_info, get_public_info_api_info, or get_strategy_vault_api_info, and for addresses use get_contract_addresses.

detail.description: 'summary' (default) truncates long documentation sections to keep responses compact; 'full' returns complete section text

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

query.description: Search query about Orderly Network (e.g., 'how does the vault work', 'trading fees', 'order types')

scope.description: Which corpus to search: 'sdk' for type-accurate SDK symbols (hooks/components/types/functions), 'docs' for protocol documentation, or 'auto' (default) which detects intent from the query (camelCase/use* names → SDK, plain language → docs)

name: search_orderly_docs
